company_name: Ching Hung Machinery & Electric Industrial Co., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Ching Hung Machinery specializes in electrical discharge machining (EDM) equipment, which is relevant for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ching Hung Machinery & Electric Industrial Co., LTD. is a leading manufacturer of EDM machines, providing essential equipment for precision machining in the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include wire EDM machines and ultra-precision laser cutting systems, which are critical for semiconductor fabrication and processing.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, with a trading office and a subsidiary in mainland China.
regional_presence.China: Operates a subsidiary to support local manufacturing and sales.
